text:
Maria K: Quick sync — auditors want the SOC2 rollforward evidence (audit log retention + KMS attestation) consolidated by Mon 2026-04-06. Can owners confirm status and blockers?

Alice W: I'm owner for audit-log intake. Blocked until schema PR merges. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/489 — needs eng-platform review.

Ben R: Platform, I can review today. Sam, can you drop a small staging sample so I can validate the schema change end-to-end? :eyes: 

Sam T: Dropping sample now — saved to staging S3: s3://redwood-staging/audit-samples/sample-20260301.json.gz

Sam T: Quick fetch one-liner for reviewers: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-staging/audit-samples/sample-20260301.json.gz - | zcat | jq . | head```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted: "Staging cutover scheduled 2026-03-29 01:00 UTC (maintenance window)."

Maria K: Ownership recap: Audit-intake = Alice W; Evidence packaging = Dave L; KMS attestation = Ben R + Security. Please ack.

Dave L: Ack. Packaging script lives in infra/tools/audit-pack. I'll prepare a tarball with manifest after Alice merges the schema.

Alice W: Ack — will prioritize the PR review today and aim to merge by EOD. Heads-up: one field rename needed (event_source -> src).

Ben R: HSM attestation tests passed in staging yesterday. Final step is toggling the attestation env var on staging & prod. PR for toggle: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/512

Maria K: Can we get a short confirmation once the toggle is staged? Auditors will want the attestation run log.

Ben R: Will post the attestation run log here after toggle. No expected downtime. :thumbsup:

Sam T: Retention policy doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/audit-retention — retention=3y, lifecycle rule id=audit-2026. Also added bucket ACL note in the doc.

Maria K: Perfect. I'll assemble the evidence checklist once we have: merged PR, attestation log, packaged tarball, and retention doc link.

Alice W: small blocker still: one consumer (analytics) needs to handle the renamed field. I opened an RFC to coordinate: https://go.redwood/rfcs/analytics-audit-field. If someone from analytics can ack, we can merge.

Ben R: I'll ping analytics owners in #eng-platform. @Alice W, if merge happens by EOD I'll run the integration smoke and post results.

Dave L: Packaging note: prefer a signed tarball and SHA256 checksum for evidence. I'll generate both and upload to the evidence bucket.

Maria K: Thanks everyone. Final question — any risk to meeting the 2026-04-06 auditor snapshot? If yes, call it out now.

Alice W: Risk = low, dependent on analytics ack. Expect resolution today.

Ben R: Low risk. I'll post attestation log by EOD after toggle.

Sam T: No infra blockers from my side.

Maria K: Great. I'll track in the SOC2 board and ping again tomorrow with a short status update. :white_check_mark: 

Dave L: FYI I'll add the signed tarball link to the board as soon as it's ready.

Maria K: Thank you — closing this quick sync. If anything changes, reply here so I capture it in the evidence packet.
